recipes.name: Peanut Butter Caramel Latte
instructions: Add all of the ingredients together to a high-speed blender. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a saucepan over medium-high heat and stir continuously to prevent burning until heated through. If you prefer a thinner consistency, add some more plant milk.
Pour into your favourite mugs, add maple syrup if desired for more sweetness, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Best to enjoy this immediately.
